title: Existence of hypercyclic algebras in Fréchet algebras
summary: We prove that every separable infinite-dimensional Fréchet algebra $X$ admits a continuous linear operator $T$ supporting a dense invariant hypercyclic algebra, giving an affirmative answer to a question of Bayart, Costa Jr. and Papathanasiou. In fact, every dense countable-dimensional subalgebra $\mathcal A$ of $X$ can be prescribed as an invariant hypercyclic algebra.
